name: Sidney Tarbell
bio: Sidney Tarbell was named to a committee at a Mingusville stockmen's meeting on March 31, 1886 and elected foreman of round-up No. 7. In May 1886 he was listed as foreman of District No. 7.
mentions: …that Glendive creek be included in district No. 7.  On motions of Ward, Goodall and Singleton, Messrs. Sidney Tarbell, George Towers and D. C. Rowe were appointed as the above-mentioned committee.  On motion of D. C. Rowe, Sidney Tarbell was elected foreman of round-up No. 7.  On motion…
…the Yellowstone; thence working down the south side of the Yellowstone and tributaries to Fort Buford. S. H. Tarbell, foreman.
